mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS sourceId,m.projectId AS originalProjectId,m.projectType,m.memberRole,m.memberCode,m.memberName,m.phoneNum,m.email,m.fromFlag,m.createTime,m.createBy AS source_creator,m.updateTime,m.updateBy AS source_updater,m.effectiveFrom,m.effectiveTo AS originalEffectiveTo,CASE WHEN m.effectiveTo < m.effectiveFrom THEN m.effectiveFrom ELSE m.effectiveTo END AS effectiveTo FROM pm_project_member m WHERE m.projectType='10' AND m.memberRole IN ('10','20','30','60') AND m.projectId IN #{key}AND 1=0 ORDER BY m.id LIMIT #{limit}
